source_device_missing_retry: Source device is missing. Retry in 10 minutes.
source_device_missing_retry_named: Source device %name% is missing. Retry in 10 minutes.
error_device_not_ready: Device is not ready. Ignoring new settings!
error_appliance_not_learned: Program not learned yet: needs __runs__ runs
error_appliance_ev_charger: This source is already counted by an EV charger device
error_appliance_homey_device: Only for a Homey device as source, not for Homey Energy or flow
appliance_status: __runs__ runs, __kwh__ kWh, __duration__ min, peak __peak__ W, __starts__ starts/week
error_budget_custom_12: Custom budget does not have 12 number values
error_budget_months: Enter 12 months, with a total above 0
error_start_date: Start date must be ddmm, e.g. 0101
error_budget_invalid: Budget is not a valid number
error_total_invalid: A total cannot go against the counting direction of the meter.
error_no_location: No location available in device settings
error_setup_caps_missing: Pick at least one meter capability, or use Watt as source.
error_setup_bat_caps_missing: Pick a state of charge and a power.
error_setup_bat_power_mixed: Pick either a power, or a charge and discharge power, not both.
solar_bootstrap_warning: Building the solar forecast model - allow up to 2 weeks of history for full accuracy.
solar_bootstrap_status: Bootstrapping - __days__ of 14 days of history collected
solar_export_diagnostics_popup: Now create an app diagnostics report with Message: panel orientation (e.g. South/East/West).
tariff_group_interval_conflict: Tariff group __group__ receives conflicting price intervals (__sources__). Using __interval__ min. Give 15- and 60-minute price devices their own tariff group.
grid_connection_multiple_devices: Multiple Grid devices found (__devices__). Using __limit__ W as the grid connection limit for power plausibility checks. Keep only one Grid device.
migration_dap_replace: DAP devices are replaced by the new Energy Price device (__devices__). Add an Energy Price device: it takes over the settings.
migration_dap_flows: __old__ is taken over by __new__. Adjust these flows, then delete __old__: __flows__
migration_dap_delete: __old__ is taken over by __new__. Check your flows, then delete __old__.
migration_warning_replace: Replaced by Energy Price. Add an Energy Price device.
migration_warning_taken: Taken over by __new__. Adjust flows, then delete this device.

repair.ev_caps_text: Which capability of the charger and the car to use. Automatic: recognised by its id.
repair.setup_power_unmeasured: 0 = automatic: not measured yet, __power__ W until then.
repair.setup_caps_text: Which capability to use. Automatic: as detected.
repair.setup_no_dap_plan: No Energy Price device found. The charge plan needs one: add it first. Outside its markets, provide its prices by flow (prices JSON).
repair.setup_bat_external: To control it, set the battery's own app to external control.
repair.start_question: What do you want to do?
repair.start_source_info: Keeps all insights and flows. If the new source has a different meter reading, fix the totals afterwards.
repair.start_fix_info: After a wrong meter jump, or to set the totals so far after pairing.
repair.fix_totals: Totals this day, month or year
repair.fix_totals_info: The total since the start of the period. The meter reading itself stays the same.
repair.fix_none: Nothing to fix yet: wait for the first meter reading.
repair.setup_no_price: No Energy Price device found: add one first, also for a fixed tariff.
repair.start_budget_info: Change the year budget, its distribution and the start date of the year.

load_forecast_accuracy: Avg error __mae__ W (__pct__%), bias __bias__ W, __days__ days
error_invalid_periods: Invalid period: __periods__. Use YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD, separated by commas
error_formula_not_a_number: The formula does not give a number.

price_setup.tod_hint: Each markup applies from its time until the next time.
price_setup.weekend_hint: On Saturday and Sunday. Replaces the time of day markup.
price_setup.title: Energy Price
price_setup.contract_hint: As on your contract or price sheet.
price_setup.name: Name
price_setup.preview_none: No market price available right now.
price_setup.error_tod: Invalid time of day markup. Use hour:markup;hour:markup.
price_setup.error_use_repair: Change the energy or bidding zone via Repair.
price_setup.group_auto: New devices use this price automatically.
price_setup.import_hint: The old device then stops sending its price to the group.

battery_learned.reset_hint: For another battery, or when the learned values are clearly wrong. Learning starts over.

fuse_import: Main fuse protection: import __import__ W above __limit__ W for 30 s. The batteries could not prevent it, no EV charger to cut.
fuse_import_ev_limited: Main fuse protection: import __import__ W above __limit__ W for 30 s. __charger__ limited to __power__ W.
fuse_import_ev_off: Main fuse protection: import __import__ W above __limit__ W for 30 s. __charger__ switched off.
fuse_export: Main fuse protection: export __export__ W above __limit__ W for 30 s. The batteries could not prevent it.
warning_no_price_device: No Energy Price device in the tariff group: the price stays at the last one. Add a Energy Price device and choose its group in the settings.
error_setup_no_price: Choose a tariff group with a Energy Price device. Add a Energy Price device first if there is none.

budget.start_date_info: The month and year totals start again on this day and month. Every month starts on this day, or on its last day when it is shorter.
budget.target_info_solar: Leave empty to estimate it from the peak power and your location.
budget.custom_text: Fill in the budget per month, or enter a year total and spread it.
